task_definition: Binary classification of a candidate healthcare answer as supported or hallucinated using the supplied question and evidence.

source_policy.training: Med-HALT Reasoning FCT dev plus Med-HALT Reasoning Fake train question groups.
source_policy.validation: Med-HALT Reasoning FCT val plus a held-out group-disjoint portion of Med-HALT Reasoning Fake train.
source_policy.frozen_test: A fixed, balanced, question-group-disjoint subset drawn only from the original Med-HALT Reasoning FCT test split.

leakage_controls: All answer variants for the same normalized question are kept in one split.
No original Med-HALT FCT test question group is used for training or validation.
The frozen test benchmark is selected deterministically with seed 42.
Each selected question group contributes one supported and one hallucinated answer.
